feed.headline: Serbia’s Longtime President Aleksandar Vucic Resigns Post
feed.ai: Aleksandar Vucic, one of Europe’s longest-serving leaders, resigned as president, paving the way for him to become prime minister after elections next month.

feed.headline: Turkish comedian Deniz Göktaş on trial for insulting President Erdoğan in standup show
feed.ai: Göktaş's arrest was the latest in a widening crackdown on anyone seen as critical of Turkey's conservative government or its values, which has netted hundreds of politicians, artists, musicians, journalists and LGBTQ+ activists.

feed.headline: Serbia's politicians return to TV debates ahead of parliamentary election
feed.ai: A month before the early parliamentary elections, Serbia's high ranking politicians from the ruling and opposition parties engaged in a debate on the N1 channel after a prolonged boycott between the anti-government station and officials. The ownership change provided a new opportunity for dialogue.
